scripts.name: ServiceTitan Appointment Sync
scripts.description: Terros to ServiceTitan: one-way sync of Consultation events to jobs and appointments.

authSchema.appKey: ServiceTitan application key with access to the configured tenant.
authSchema.clientId: ServiceTitan OAuth client ID for this install.
authSchema.clientSecret: ServiceTitan OAuth client secret for this install.
authSchema.tenantId: Required. Numeric ServiceTitan ID of the tenant to synchronize.

configSchema.name: jobTypeId
configSchema.description: Required. Numeric ServiceTitan ID of the job type used for new jobs.

configSchema.name: serviceTitanJobId
configSchema.description: Required. Terros account text custom field ID (CF.*) storing the ServiceTitan job ID.

configSchema.name: cancelReasonId
configSchema.description: Required. Numeric ServiceTitan ID of the job cancellation reason used when a closer is reassigned.

configSchema.name: customFieldCustomerId
configSchema.description: Optional. Numeric ServiceTitan ID of the customer custom field type storing the Terros account ID; enables customer deduplication.

configSchema.name: customFieldLocationId
configSchema.description: Optional. Numeric ServiceTitan ID of the location custom field type storing the Terros account ID.

configSchema.name: customFieldSetter
configSchema.description: Optional. Numeric ServiceTitan ID of the job custom field type storing the owner name.

configSchema.name: customFieldAppointmentOutcome
configSchema.description: Optional. Numeric ServiceTitan ID of the job custom field type storing the event status.

configSchema.name: campaignIdSetterGen
configSchema.description: Optional. Numeric ServiceTitan ID of the campaign for an owner with Needs_Help closer status.

configSchema.name: campaignIdCloserGen
configSchema.description: Optional. Numeric ServiceTitan ID of the fallback closer-generated campaign.

configSchema.name: campaignIdUnknown
configSchema.description: Optional. Numeric ServiceTitan ID of the final fallback campaign. Configure at least one campaign applicable to each owner.

configSchema.name: teamToBusinessUnitMap
configSchema.description: Optional. ServiceTitan technician team name to business unit mapping; each value is a numeric ServiceTitan ID. Unmapped technicians use their own business unit.

configSchema.name: dryRun
configSchema.description: Optional. true or false, default false. true logs the ServiceTitan and Terros writes this sync would make and does not send them. Disable the legacy ServiceTitan webhook before setting this to false, or both create jobs.
